title: Korean War Veterans Memorial Wall Groundbreaking Ceremony : CSPAN2 : May 24, 2021 10:09am-10:36am EDT
summary: The Korean War Veterans Memorial Foundation hosted a groundbreaking ceremony for the Korean War Veterans Memorial Wall of Remembrance at the National Mall in Washington, DC. South Korean President Moon Jae-In attended the ceremony and made brief remarks. Sponsor: Korean War Veterans Memorial Foundation
